parameters.content:
## RALI handoff alert

Manual demo over synthetic lifecycle events. Build the dbt mart, then run sql/01_handoff_notification_log.sql and sql/02_handoff_owner_directory.sql. Configure Postgres and Slack in n8n, and populate the owner directory privately. Each manual run selects at most one unlogged exception. Review the message before enabling. If Slack succeeds but the log write fails, inspect Slack before retrying to avoid a duplicate.

parameters.query:
SELECT e.account_id, e.account_name, e.territory, e.owner_key, e.closed_won_at, e.exception_type, e.source_system, e.notification_key, e.next_action, owner.recipient_ref
FROM marts.mart_handoff_exceptions e
JOIN raw.handoff_owner_directory owner ON e.owner_key = owner.owner_key
LEFT JOIN raw.handoff_notification_log sent ON e.notification_key = sent.notification_key
WHERE sent.notification_key IS NULL AND e.handoff_due_at <= current_timestamp
ORDER BY e.closed_won_at, e.account_id
LIMIT 1;
